name: Ogose (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ogose town emblem in navy: a ring enclosing a stylised peak above wavy lines, with the character 越 at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Ogose, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 19 February 1973.

features.role: Ogose town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised peak above wavy lines, with the character 越 at the top
